## About

- **Software developer at [Agrileaf](https://agrileaf.in)**: full-stack business apps with React and Django. Before that, real-time computer vision for agriculture and industrial inspection (YOLO11), and Raspberry Pi systems driving actuators and sensors.
- **Now building**: SwingTrade AI, an NSE swing screener with 21 setup detectors, regime detection and a backtester; and Contribution Finder, which matches your GitHub skills to open-source issues and explains every match.
- **Off the clock**: photography, shot and edited in Lightroom. Movies, web series and anime.

#### Private, in development

- **SwingTrade AI** (v0.41): NSE swing-trade screener with 21 setup detectors, regime detection, risk-based sizing, alerts and a 22-strategy backtester. *Django · Celery · Redis · React · TypeScript*
- **Contribution Finder** (v0.12): matches a developer's GitHub skills to open-source repos and issues, with an evidence-backed reason for every pick. *Django 5 · DRF · Celery · pgvector · React 19 · TypeScript*
- **Expense Tracker** (v1.7): self-hosted personal finance covering budgets, debts, investments and net worth, with 20+ planning tools. *React 19 · Django 6 · Celery · PostgreSQL*
- **FitTrack** (v0.9): fitness tracker with a 1,500+ movement library, workout plans, session logging and progress stats. *Django 6 · React 19 · TypeScript*
- **Swing-Trade Research** (v0.39): walk-forward research on systematic NSE portfolio strategies, with cost-aware LightGBM. *Python · Django · Pandas · LightGBM · PyTorch*
- **NSE Signal Bot & Backtester** (w/ [@Tilak004](https://github.com/Tilak004)): Pine Script signals, a 10-year Python backtester, and a daily NSE alert bot. *Python · Pandas · Pine Script · Streamlit*
- **Gym Management**: two-portal gym operations covering members, plans, trainers, attendance and payments. *Django 5 · DRF · React 19 · PostgreSQL*
- **Chore App**: office chore tracking and assignment. *Node.js · Express · React 19 · SQLite*
- **Blog Platform**: personal blog with a draft and publish workflow. *Django 6 · SQLite*
